help.tips[0].examples[0].en: A sunny, successful, dreamlike day – and free.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: Since the factory closed, many people have been unemployed.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: -reich means 'rich in': Erfolg + -reich = erfolgreich, full of success.
help.tips[0].en.text: Freund → freundlich · Sonne → sonnig · Kind → kindisch (childish; kindlich = childlike) · Traum → traumhaft · Arbeit → arbeitslos · Kalorien → kalorienarm · Erfolg → erfolgreich · Wert → wertvoll. Umlaut often appears: Angst → ängstlich, Kraft → kräftig; but not always: Mut → mutig.
help.tips[0].en.title: Noun → adjective: -lich, -ig, -isch, -haft, -los, -arm, -reich, -voll
help.tips[0].en.trap: kindisch (childish, negative) vs kindlich (childlike, neutral); -isch tends to judge, -lich to describe. Similarly launisch (moody) vs the neutral -lich forms.
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: The method is effective, economical and understandable to everyone.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: The doctor can be reached by phone during the day.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: Verb + -bar means 'can be …-ed': machbar = can be done.
help.tips[1].en.text: erreichen → erreichbar (can be reached) · wirken → wirksam · sparen → sparsam · verstehen → verständlich · kreieren → kreativ · produzieren → produktiv. -bar is the productive one: any transitive verb + -bar = 'can be …-ed'.
help.tips[1].en.title: Verb → adjective: -bar, -sam, -lich, -iv
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: Meaningful or pointless? Patient or impatient? Low-fat or high-fat?
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: Unfortunately the instructions are completely incomprehensible.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: un- is the default way to negate an adjective; nicht- doesn't attach to adjectives, and -los attaches to nouns.
help.tips[2].en.text: un-: unfreundlich, ungeduldig, unmöglich (the default) · -los: hilflos, sinnlos, arbeitslos (without) · a-: asozial · des-: desinteressiert · ir-/in-/il-: irrational, inakzeptabel, illegal · miss-: missverständlich. Pairs: -voll ↔ -los (sinnvoll / sinnlos), -reich ↔ -arm (fettreich / fettarm).
help.tips[2].en.title: Negation: un-, -los, and the Latin prefixes
help.tips[3].examples[0].en: Normally I cycle; as an exception I'm taking the car today.
help.tips[3].examples[1].en: As an exception we are going by car today.
help.tips[3].check.whyEn: -weise attaches to the adjective with -er- in between: glücklich → glücklicherweise.
help.tips[3].en.text: glücklicherweise (luckily), normalerweise (normally), teilweise (partly), beispielsweise (for example), möglicherweise (possibly), ausnahmsweise (as an exception). Add -weise and you have a sentence adverb for your Stellungnahme.
help.tips[3].en.title: -weise turns it into an adverb of manner
help.context.en: The new café is friendly, sunny and astonishingly good value. The range is varied, the cakes dreamlike, the waiters attentive and – unusually for the area – never impatient. Only drawback: it can only be reached by bike, which for families with many children is possibly impractical. As an exception, the coffee is even free.
help.hookEn: Know a handful of suffixes like -bar, -los and -reich and you can decode adjectives you've never seen before.
help.introEn: Adjectives are built from nouns and verbs with a set of suffixes, each with a rough meaning. -lich (like, related to): freundlich, täglich, gefährlich, verständlich. -ig (having, full of): sonnig, mutig, hungrig, ruhig. -isch (of the kind, often nationalities or negative): kindisch, europäisch, praktisch, launisch. -sam (tending to): wirksam, sparsam, langsam, aufmerksam. -haft (having the quality of): traumhaft, fehlerhaft, lebhaft. -bar (can be): erreichbar, machbar, sichtbar, unglaublich (-lich variant). -los (without): arbeitslos, hilflos, sinnlos, kostenlos. -arm / -reich (poor / rich in): kalorienarm, fettarm; erfolgreich, abwechslungsreich, hilfreich. -voll (full of): wertvoll, sinnvoll, verantwortungsvoll. -iv (from Latin): kreativ, aktiv, produktiv. And negation prefixes: un- (unfreundlich, ungeduldig), a- (asozial), des- (desinteressiert), ir- (irrational), in- (inakzeptabel), miss- (missverständlich), plus -los as a negating suffix. The suffix -weise makes adverbs of manner: glücklicherweise (luckily), teilweise (partly), beispielsweise (for example). These build a large share of the adjectives in any newspaper — and let you decode words you have never seen.
help.rememberEn[1]: un- is the default negation; -los = without; -weise = adverb.
sentences[10].whyEn: kreieren → kreativ — the -iv adjective, + -e in the plural.
sentences[13].whyEn: -weise makes the adverb: ausnahmsweise — with a linking s.
